rag.answer:
Uber reported **2021 revenue of $17.455 billion** in its 2021 Form 10-K.[1] Its current market capitalization is approximately **$164 billion**.[2]

\[
\text{Price-to-sales ratio}=\frac{\$164\text{ billion}}{\$17.455\text{ billion}}\approx 9.4\times
\]

**Approximate P/S ratio: 9.4×**.

Market capitalization changes with Uber’s share price, so the ratio will fluctuate.[1][2]

[2] [Uber market capitalization — CompaniesMarketCap](https://companiesmarketcap.com/uber/marketcap/)
